summary: As designated security owner (Opus4.8 HIGH) I classify tree 9d0c4c16244230acb3e04f8b96896a9c15d79c58 as a low-risk, control-PRESERVING dependency-gating refactor whose feature boundary is ADEQUATE on the evidence shown.
